references.text: Like a tree planted by flowing water that yields its fruit in due season and whose leaves do not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

For as the rain and snow come down from heaven and do not return there but water the earth, making it bring forth and sprout, giving seed to the sower and bread to the eater, so shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and succeed in the thing for which I sent it.
But those on the good soil are the ones who hear the word and hold fast to it in an honest and good heart, and bear fruit with patience.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.
